title: Prime Minister shares a Sanskrit Subhashitam, highlighting the selfless devotion of noble people to the welfare of others
body_text:
Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam today, highlighting that noble people are always devoted to the welfare of others, acting selflessly without expectations, much like divine jewels that radiate their own light. The Prime Minister wrote on X; "अपेक्षन्ते न च स्नेहं न पात्रं न दशान्तरम्। सदा लोकहिते युक्ता रत्नदीपा इवोत्तमाः।।" Noble people are always devoted to the welfare of others. In their selfless endeavours, they neither expect affection nor concern themselves with the worthiness of the recipient or the prevailing circumstances. They are like divine jewels that radiate their own light. अपेक्षन्ते न च स्नेहं न पात्रं न दशान्तरम्।

सदा लोकहिते युक्ता रत्नदीपा इवोत्तमाः।। https://t.co/XqJhzDgR7t — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) November 12, 2026 **** MJPS/SS/PRK
